workflow: A parser obtains a borrowed pointer to an event name stored in a sequence it owns.
An unsupported event enters an error path that releases the sequence before formatting the diagnostic.
Releasing the sequence deallocates the event-name storage while the borrowed pointer remains reachable.
Diagnostic construction reads the released storage, causing a use-after-free instead of returning a recoverable invalid-event error.
summary: Borrowed diagnostic data outlives its owning sequence
decision_reason: The failure is materially the same as retained pointer dereferencing after its owner releases storage: an error path releases the owner before later using a borrowed pointer into the released data.
